title: governance.sla_breached.v1
description: Integration-contract v1 for the SLA breach fact (EDR-REMEDIATION-01 D1). One Finding's current SLA period ran past its due date. Emitted once per period. It is a FACT, never a transition: no Position, stage or proposal changes because of it (S1).

Bucket.description: The severity bucket frozen when the Finding first had a score. Empty when only a CISA KEV due date set the deadline.

PeriodStart.description: When this SLA period began: creation, or the moment the Finding returned to the queue after an acceptance.

KEVDueApplied.description: CISA's KEV due date was earlier than the policy's and is the deadline.
